title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain George Washington University
description: Ten named, under-21-safe food stops on or near the Foggy Bottom campus with currently posted evening availability.

cards.title: Carvings
cards.subtitle: 2021 F Street NW, near Foggy Bottom campus
cards.notes: Use the posted hours before leaving; this campus-adjacent deli lists service through midnight Sunday–Wednesday and later on Thursday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A named campus-adjacent deli with posted midnight-and-later hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Carvings lists hours of 8 AM–midnight Sunday–Wednesday, 8 AM–2 AM Thursday, and 8 AM–3 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Sun–Wed 8 AM–12 AM; Thu 8 AM–2 AM; Fri–Sat 8 AM–3 AM. Confirm before visiting.

cards.title: DC Pizza
cards.subtitle: 1103 19th Street NW, Golden Triangle
cards.notes: Plan this for the late-week window and check the restaurant page first; the official listing gives Thursday through Saturday late-night closing times.
cards.short_summary: A 19th Street pizza stop with official late-week hours.
cards.evidence_claim: DC Pizza lists Thursday hours until 3 AM and Friday–Saturday hours until 4 AM.
cards.access_notes: Posted late hours: Thursday until 3 AM; Friday and Saturday until 4 AM. Other days close at 9 PM.

cards.title: University Student Center
cards.subtitle: 800 21st Street NW, GW Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: Check the semester dining schedule and head to the first floor when its listed late window is active; hours vary by day and academic period.
cards.short_summary: GW’s student center is a documented late campus dining location.
cards.evidence_claim: GW Dining’s Fall 2025 schedule lists University Student Center retail dining until 11 PM Monday–Wednesday and until 1 AM Thursday–Friday.
cards.source_title: GW Dining — Fall 2025 Hours of Operations
cards.access_notes: Fall 2025 posted retail hours: Mon–Wed 11 AM–11 PM; Thu–Fri 11 AM–1 AM. Schedule is semester-specific; confirm current hours.

cards.title: District House
cards.subtitle: 2121 H Street NW, GW Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: Use the posted dining schedule and the building’s named food options for an on-campus evening meal; confirm the day’s hours before you go.
cards.short_summary: A GW dining building with four named quick-service concepts.
cards.evidence_claim: GW identifies District House at 2121 H Street NW and lists D.C. Taco House, Baba’s Pizza, Halal Shack, and True Burger; its Fall 2025 schedule lists 11 AM–9 PM daily.
cards.access_notes: GW’s Fall 2025 hours document lists District House retail dining daily from 11 AM–9 PM. Confirm current schedule before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Panda Express at Science & Engineering Hall
cards.title: Panda Express at Science & Engineering Hall
cards.subtitle: 800 22nd Street NW, GW Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: Check the current GW dining schedule before heading over; this named campus location’s posted daily service window extends into the evening.
cards.short_summary: A named retail dining option inside GW’s Science & Engineering Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: GW Dining’s Fall 2025 schedule lists Panda Express at Science & Engineering Hall, 800 22nd Street NW, from 10:30 AM to 11 PM Monday–Sunday.
cards.source_title: GW Dining — Fall 2025 Hours of Operations
cards.access_notes: Fall 2025 posted hours: 10:30 AM–11 PM daily. Schedule is semester-specific; confirm current hours.

cards.title: Shenkman Hall Dining
cards.subtitle: 616 23rd Street NW, GW Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: Consult the current dining schedule before setting out; Shenkman combines all-you-care-to-eat dining, Sushi Do, and a market in one named campus building.
cards.short_summary: An evening dining hall and market location at GW.
cards.evidence_claim: GW identifies Shenkman Hall at 616 23rd Street NW and its Fall 2025 schedule lists dinner until 10 PM Monday–Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Fall 2025 posted dining-hall dinner ends at 10 PM Monday–Thursday; Friday and weekend schedules differ. Confirm current hours.

cards.title: Thurston Hall Dining
cards.subtitle: 1900 F Street NW, GW Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: Check the dining calendar before an evening visit; this named GW dining hall has a posted weeknight dinner service ending at 10 PM.
cards.short_summary: A named Foggy Bottom dining hall with documented evening service.
cards.evidence_claim: GW Dining’s Fall 2025 schedule lists Thurston at 1900 F Street NW with dinner served until 10 PM Monday–Thursday.
cards.source_title: GW Dining — Fall 2025 Hours of Operations
cards.access_notes: Fall 2025 posted dinner hours: Monday–Thursday until 10 PM; Friday until 9 PM; weekend schedule differs. Confirm current hours.

cards.title: Andy’s Pizza — Foggy Bottom
cards.subtitle: 2000 Pennsylvania Avenue NW, Lobby 014
cards.notes: Use the location page for the day’s service window; this named Foggy Bottom shop posts the same 10 PM close every day of the week.
cards.short_summary: A Foggy Bottom pizza shop with a consistent posted nightly closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Andy’s Pizza lists its Foggy Bottom location at 2000 Pennsylvania Avenue NW and posts daily hours of 11 AM–10 PM.
cards.source_title: Andy's Pizza — Foggy Bottom Hours & Location
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: 11 AM–10 PM Monday–Sunday. Confirm current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Western Market
cards.subtitle: 2000 Pennsylvania Avenue NW, Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: Check the market and individual stall schedules before walking over; the market posts 10 PM closing daily, while vendors may keep different hours.
cards.short_summary: A named Foggy Bottom food hall open until 10 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Western Market identifies itself as located in Foggy Bottom and posts hours until 10 PM daily, noting that individual stalls may vary.
cards.access_notes: Posted market hours: 7 AM–10 PM weekdays and 8 AM–10 PM weekends; individual stalls may vary. Confirm before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Bodega Taqueria y Tequila — Foggy Bottom
cards.title: Bodega Taqueria — Foggy Bottom
cards.subtitle: 2127 I Street NW, near GW Foggy Bottom
cards.notes: Use the taqueria service hours rather than event listings, and verify the day before going; its food counter posts late weekday and weekend availability.
cards.short_summary: A named I Street taqueria with official midnight-and-later service windows.
cards.evidence_claim: Bodega’s Foggy Bottom location lists taqueria hours through midnight Monday–Wednesday, 1 AM Thursday, 2 AM Friday, and 3 AM Saturday.
cards.source_title: Bodega Taqueria y Tequila — Foggy Bottom
cards.access_notes: Posted taqueria hours: Mon–Wed until 12 AM, Thu until 1 AM, Fri until 2 AM, Sat until 3 AM; Sunday is listed closed for summer. Confirm current hours.

warnings: GW’s published campus dining hours are semester-specific; each campus card’s access notes instructs visitors to confirm the current schedule.
